entries.prompt: Create one polished desktop application UI concept screenshot, 1536x1024 landscape, for ATLAS, an immersive premium ride-booking web app with Earth and Galactic modes. Show the GALACTIC mode selected in a segmented switch near the top left. The user supplied a Star Trek Galactic Atlas reference board with deep navy space, pale ice-blue map symbols and warm muted gold LCARS elbows; reinterpret its blue/gold visual identity into a sophisticated functional ride-booking screen, never reproduce the blurry phone screenshot. Full-bleed exceptionally detailed photographic space environment, crisp fine stars, dramatic delicate indigo/cyan nebula wisps with a luminous ochre planet in upper right and small icy planet lower center. Spatial depth and actual cinematic art direction, dark negative space behind floating labels. Geographic-looking delicate orbital routes and tiny map labels Vulcan, Earth, Andoria. A luminous cyan curved selected travel route between Earth and Vulcan. Left floating booking panel 350px wide, soft raised dark ink material, fine rim light, restrained gold corner detail, clear editable-looking typography, title 'Where to, Captain?', two input rows 'Earth · Spacedock' and 'Vulcan · ShiKahr', route summary '6.2 light-years · Warp corridor 04', three compact horizontal vehicle choice rows 'Shuttle', 'Runabout', 'Starship', selected Runabout has gold border, main wide gold button 'Request Runabout'. Top thin transparent navigation with ATLAS wordmark, Earth/Galactic switch, 'My trips'. Bottom right compact map controls plus minus and recenter. Route endpoint labels floating over the actual map. Bottom right discrete legend 'Illustrative sector · Booking simulation'. No marketing landing page, no dashboard charts, no giant copy, no stacked generic cards. Design primary purpose is choosing pickup and destination and booking a ride, map fills viewport, real readable interface, close-up straight-on screenshot not a device mockup. High craft, tactile depth, restrained control density, professional responsive product design.

entries.prompt: Generate a premium cinematic astronomical environment texture for an interactive galactic ride-booking map. Landscape 1536x1024 or larger native resolution, exceptionally sharp native fine stars and dimensional luminous wisps. NO TEXT, NO LABELS, NO UI, NO LOGOS, NO MAP LINES, NO SPACECRAFT. Deep ink black outer space with softly structured indigo nebula across center sweeping diagonally from lower left to upper right, faint ice-cyan dust filaments on right and subtle warm ochre dusty light at upper right. Sophisticated scientific astrophotography aesthetic, many very fine tiny pin-sharp stars with a handful of luminous bright stars, contrast-controlled, strong depth and negative space. Left 30 percent mostly dark, allowing a floating booking panel; central/right area rich detailed clouds but not bright white. Beautiful, immersive, restrained and photorealistic. This is a standalone full-resolution background art asset, not a screenshot, not a poster. Do not draw planets; interactive planets will be added separately in production.

entries.prompt: A premium cinematic sci-fi UI asset sheet with a fully transparent alpha background, landscape 1536x1024 or higher. FOUR isolated objects on a strict 2x2 equal grid, each object entirely within its quadrant with wide transparent margins and NO overlap. Top left: a beautiful spherical Earth planet with blue oceans, atmospheric blue rim, white clouds and nighttime city lights, illuminated upper left. Top right: ochre rocky alien planet Vulcan with rugged rust and gold mineral surface, warm sunlit crescent on upper right, shadowed hemisphere, spherical sharp silhouette. Bottom left: icy blue alien moon with pale cyan atmospheric rim and fine surface details, spherical sharp silhouette. Bottom right: sleek silver futuristic runabout shuttle spacecraft with two short nacelles and small cyan engine glow, three-quarter view angled toward upper left, exquisite photographic metal detail. All four are true photorealistic high-quality 3D rendered subjects for a space rideshare app, not simplified vector icons, no text no logos no panel backgrounds no stars no borders. Camera static and excellent shape separation. Sharp silhouettes, preserve actual transparent background. Each object occupies about 65-75 percent of its own quadrant.

entries.role: Three surface maps cropped by row, wrapped on shader-rendered spheres.
entries.acceptance: Accepted for illustrative surface detail and separate albedo. These are generated materials, not NASA scientific surface maps; texture longitude seams and axial alignment are not certified.
entries.prompt: Create a technically usable 3-row texture atlas, 1536x1024 or higher, containing THREE seamless horizontal equirectangular planetary surface texture maps with NO drawn spheres, NO shadows, NO lighting gradients, NO text, NO borders, NO transparent space. Each of the three full-width equal-height horizontal strips must fill its entire strip edge to edge. All strips must be seamlessly tileable left-to-right. Top third: Earth-like blue oceans, recognizable green/brown land masses and wispy white cloud systems seen in full cylindrical equirectangular projection, detailed satellite imagery, balanced exposure. Middle third: Vulcan-like arid alien world, rich ochre and rust rock, fine crater details, ridges and continental geological structures, natural tan/gold hue, homogeneous lighting across the entire image. Bottom third: Andoria-like icy planet, detailed pale cyan glacier patterns, dark cobalt ice fissures and frosty continents, fine realistic satellite detail. Purpose is raw color/albedo texture data to wrap around physically shaded rotating interactive 3D globes. Flat surface texture atlas only; DO NOT draw spherical planets or space scenes. Professional high-resolution planetary material maps, no labels or any UI.
